newsitem.title: USA: Dayton Hudson debt rating reaffirmed.
newsitem.headline: Dayton Hudson debt rating reaffirmed.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it reaffirmed its ratings on Dayton Hudson Corp's debt after the company said it would pare 35 of its 300 Mervyn's stores.
The retailer's senior unsecured debt is rated at single-A-minus and its commercial paper is rated D-1-minus, Duff & Phelps said.

"While operating profits will be affected by the real estate sales and store closures, the earnings reduction will be substantially offset by interest expense savings," Duff & Phelps said in a research report.
The ratings apply to about $4.3 billion in outstanding debt, Duff & Phelps said.
